Subject: Hosted API capacity & pricing — StratusCare monthly token shape + peak concurrency (recap and asks)

Thanks for the time today — quick recap and two asks so we can get you a clean hosted pricing recommendation.

What I heard (please correct if I mis-summarize):
- Primary product: patient intake + triage chat flows for virtual clinics (mix of short prompts + longer context for medical history).
- Expected steady-state: roughly 20–30M tokens / month in the first 6 months as you roll out to 20 clinics.
- Peak patterns: daily morning spikes and a weekly batch window for nightly summaries — you expect short bursts up to ~200 TPS 99th percentile during peak launch events.
- Budget target: you noted a target in the low-mid $20s per 1M tokens for hosted (goal is to keep unit economics < $25/1M).

Asks / next steps for pricing: (1) can you share a recent traffic dump or an approximate token histogram (tokens per request, avg/day, 99th TPS) so I can validate our concurrency sizing and cost bands; (2) confirm whether the SLA needs to include 99th-percentile latency commitments or if a best-effort with fallback model is acceptable for launch.

I attached a short template to capture the traffic snapshot if easier (StratusCare_traffic_snapshot.csv). If you prefer, send the raw numbers inline. Once we have the shape I will:
- produce 2 hosted pricing scenarios (conservative + optimized) with estimated $/1M and expected latency bands;
- map a recommended burst-capacity plan (reserved + burst) for the first 60 days;
- propose a small pilot credit to exercise the integration and validate real TPS.

Proposed timeline: you share traffic snapshot by EOD Mon (7/9) -> I send pricing scenarios by Wed (7/11).

Thanks again — appreciate the clear signal on budget target, that helps.

— Jordan

Jordan — thanks for the clear recap. Confirming numbers and attaching a small sample: StratusCare_traffic_snapshot.csv. Key items below.

Traffic snapshot (last 30 days, sampled):
- Estimated monthly tokens (current internal pilot): 8.5M tokens / month.
- Projected public launch (month 3): 28–36M tokens / month (we expect to hit ~30M quickly if pilot adoption converts).
- Tokens per request: median ~150 tokens, mean ~380 (we have longer history ingestion flows that skew mean).
- Peak concurrency: observed spike during onboarding window = 210 TPS (1-minute sample); we plan to protect for up to 240 TPS as a safety margin for launch events.
- 99th percentile latency sensitivity: important for triage flows — we'd like < 600ms for 99th where possible.

Budget: leadership is comfortable with a hosted range of $18–$26 / 1M tokens depending on latency and SLA. They asked for a clear breakdown showing: unit token cost, expected additional egress/compute fees (if any), and any cutoff points where reserved capacity materially reduces the $/1M.

Other notes:
- We can share a short mutual action plan (MAP) doc once we validate the cost bands.
- Security: SOC2 is required — our security point will follow up with a questionnaire but that can be parallel.

Attached: StratusCare_traffic_snapshot.csv (sample) and a compact MMP_estimate_v2.xlsx we generated for internal modeling.

Let us know if you want the snapshot reformatted; happy to add per-route breakdowns.

— Leah
